title: Megaspeed says Alice Huang left in 2025 as it launches internal probe into reports about its business
summary_full: The Singapore-based cloud computing company has faced heightened scrutiny since reports linked Nvidia's Jensen Huang to former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang.
